About this home

Beautiful solid brick home located in a well established westside Tucson neighborhood. Gorgeous mountain views right outside your door. Sitting on a generous lot, this property offers space, functionality, and great potential. Inside, the home features a practical floor plan with comfortable living areas and abundant natural light. Large rooms and giant bonus room making it ideal for everyday living or entertaining. Bedrooms are nicely sized, with flexible spaces that can be customized to fit your needs. Enjoy the durability and charm of a well maintained home that is close to everything.
